en_us.gui.convert_table.growth.need_pedestal: Connect a pedestal to this crystal vein
en_us.gui.convert_table.growth.run_help: Uses the chosen recipe. The catalyst is reusable. Changing the target pauses growth and clears stored growth.
en_us.gui.convert_table.growth.catalyst_help: Insert one reusable catalyst, then choose an output.
en_us.gui.convert_table.growth.allocation_help: Export is scaled to the physical maximum of 2 E/s per immature bud. Use is scaled to the network exportable supply and shows this pedestal's actual absorption in the last server cycle. Connected pedestals share this supply.
en_us.gui.convert_table.growth.link_ready: + Container can receive the selected output
en_us.gui.convert_table.growth.link_blocked: ! Container present, but cannot receive this output
en_us.gui.convert_table.growth.credit_help: Actual stored growth / cost of one item. This is saved credit, not a timed progress bar. Changing the recipe clears it.
en_us.gui.convert_table.growth.stage_help: Bar height is the number of crystals. All four stages use the same scale.
en_us.gui.convert_table.growth.cluster_help: Mature clusters export no growth. Active production can reseed them into small buds.
en_us.gui.convert_table.growth.flow_help: Internal potential is stored growth, scaled to 25 E per immature bud. Export is scaled to the physical maximum of 2 E/s per immature bud. Use is scaled to exportable supply and shows total growth absorbed by all connected pedestals in the last server cycle; they share this supply.

zh_cn.gui.convert_table.growth.no_crystal: 需要接通一个母岩增殖台
zh_cn.gui.convert_table.growth.no_catalyst: 请放入可重复使用的触媒
zh_cn.gui.convert_table.growth.run_help: 使用选定配方增殖，触媒不会消耗。切换目标会暂停增殖并清空已存余势。
zh_cn.gui.convert_table.growth.catalyst_help: 放入一个可重复使用的触媒，再选择目标产物。
zh_cn.gui.convert_table.growth.allocation_help: 导出条的物理上限为未成熟晶芽数×2势/秒。使用条以整个网络的可导出势/秒为满刻度，显示本基座上一轮服务器实际吸收的势；多个基座共享导出额度。
zh_cn.gui.convert_table.growth.link_blocked: ! 存在容器，但无法接收该产物
zh_cn.gui.convert_table.growth.link_absent: - 此方向没有相连的产物容器
zh_cn.gui.convert_table.growth.credit_help: 实际已存余势 / 单件费用。这是可留存的余额，不是生产计时；切换配方会清空余额。
zh_cn.gui.convert_table.growth.stage_count: 已加载晶脉中有 %s 个
zh_cn.gui.convert_table.growth.stage_help: 柱高表示晶芽数量，四个阶段使用相同刻度。
zh_cn.gui.convert_table.growth.cluster_help: 成熟晶簇不再导出生长势；生产运行时可被重新播种为小晶芽。
zh_cn.gui.convert_table.growth.flow_help: 内在势表示生长势存量，满刻度为未成熟晶芽数×25势。导出条的物理上限为未成熟晶芽数×2势/秒。使用条以可导出势/秒为满刻度，显示上一轮服务器中所有相连基座实际吸收的总量；多个基座共享导出额度。
zh_cn.gui.convert_table.growth.boosts: 受增益母岩：方解石 %s，平滑玄武岩 %s
